card.name: "See" opening a warnings cross-reference
card.fires_on: The word "See" right after an opening parenthesis, pointing to another label section such as WARNINGS. It usually follows a sentence saying the drug is not approved for a use.

modes.label: See WARNINGS cross-reference
modes.description: "See" or "see" inside parentheses, introducing a pointer to a labeled section like WARNINGS.
